source_citation: Diggs, Lipscomb & O'Kennon (1999), Shinners & Mahler's Illustrated Flora of North Central Texas

morphology_source_reported.leaves: Usually 5–9 glabrous, narrow-linear to oblong leaflets, 5–12 mm long
morphology_source_reported.flowers: Pale-yellow keel; white standard and wings
morphology_source_reported.varietal_note: Historical var. pumila described as compact, generally 20–30 cm tall, with shorter denser inflorescences

cautions: Flora authors discuss possible recognition of var. pumila despite lumped treatment
